## Basecalling

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash -e

#SBATCH --account        massey03727
#SBATCH --job-name       dorado
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node  A100:1
#SBATCH --mem            20G
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task  6
#SBATCH --time           48:00:00
#SBATCH --output         dorado_basecaller.out
#SBATCH --error         %x_%j.err

module purge
module load Dorado/1.4.0

dorado download --model dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v5.2.0

#dorado basecaller <model> <reads> --kit-name <barcode-kit-name> > calls.bam
dorado basecaller --device 'cuda:all' --min-qscore 10 --no-trim sup,6mA,4mC_5mC 18Nov24/pod5/ > 18Nov24_methyl_calls.bam
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=bam2fastq
#SBATCH --account=massey03727
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --output=bam2fastq_%j.out
#SBATCH --error=bam2fastq_%j.err

module purge
module load SAMtools/1.23.1-GCC-12.3.0

PARENT_DIR="."   # directory containing the *_barcodes dirs

for dir in "${PARENT_DIR}"/*_barcodes/; do
    dir="${dir%/}"   # strip trailing slash
    dir_name=$(basename "${dir}")
    mapping_file="${dir}/${dir_name}.csv"

    echo "=== Processing directory: ${dir} ==="

    if [[ ! -f "${mapping_file}" ]]; then
        echo "  WARNING: no ${dir_name}.csv found inside ${dir}, skipping directory" >&2
        continue
    fi

    # read mapping file line by line: pattern,sample_name
    while IFS=',' read -r pattern sample_name; do
        # strip trailing carriage return / whitespace (common if CSV was
        # exported from Excel/Sheets on Windows)
        pattern="${pattern%$'\r'}"
        sample_name="${sample_name%$'\r'}"

        [[ -z "${pattern}" ]] && continue   # skip blank lines

        bam_file=$(find "${dir}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "${pattern}.bam" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
        # also allow patterns that already include .bam in the CSV
        if [[ -z "${bam_file}" ]]; then
            bam_file=$(find "${dir}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "${pattern}" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
        fi

        if [[ -z "${bam_file}" ]]; then
            echo "  WARNING: no BAM matching '${pattern}' found in ${dir}, skipping" >&2
            continue
        fi

        out_fq="${dir}/${sample_name}.fq"

        echo "  ${bam_file} -> ${out_fq}"
        if ! samtools fastq -T '*' "${bam_file}" > "${out_fq}"; then
            echo "  ERROR: samtools fastq failed on ${bam_file}, continuing with next file" >&2
            rm -f "${out_fq}"   # remove any partial/empty output
            continue
        fi

    done < "${mapping_file}"

    echo
done

echo "Done. Renamed FASTQ files written alongside their source BAMs in each *_barcodes directory."

```
